subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the updated immutable action revisions in workflows that provide OpenAI, GitHub App, and registry credentials once the current head’s checks finish?
rationale: The manifest comparison removes the prior concrete Codex-input defect, but accepting third-party action code on privileged workflow paths remains a repository security-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept after exact-head checks
options.body: Review the completed checks for the current merge result and accept the immutable pins if they remain green and no workflow behavior regresses.

options.title: Hold the sensitive action subset
options.body: Split or defer the Codex, GitHub App-token, and registry-action upgrades if the responsible owner wants separate supply-chain review.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Review the completed checks for the current merge result and accept the immutable pins if they remain green and no workflow behavior regresses.
